newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-LAZIO'S OKON FLIES TO BELGIUM FOR KNEE SURGERY.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-LAZIO'S OKON FLIES TO BELGIUM FOR KNEE SURGERY.

text.p: Lazio's Australian sweeper Paul Okon flew to Belgium on Tuesday for a cartilage operation on his right knee after taking a knock during last weekend's Serie A match against Internazionale, club doctors said.
Okon, voted Belgian league player of the year at Club Brugge last season after five years there, had already undergone surgery on his right knee before joining Lazio seven months ago.
Okon, his knee swollen after his latest injury, is likely to be out of action for two to three weeks following key-hole surgery to repair a damaged cartilage, doctors said.
